topics.title: Der September beginnt
topics.englishContext: September begins this week. Mornings are often a little cooler, and the days slowly become shorter. Many people notice that summer is coming to an end.

interestingFacts.de: Für Meteorologen beginnt der Herbst am 1. September. Astronomisch beginnt er erst am 22. oder 23. September.
interestingFacts.en: For meteorologists, autumn begins on 1 September. Astronomically, it begins only on 22 or 23 September.

topics.title: Zeit für Zwetschgenkuchen
topics.englishContext: Plums and damson plums are in season now. Bakeries often sell Zwetschgenkuchen, and many people also bake it at home. It is commonly enjoyed with coffee or cream.

interestingFacts.de: Pflaumen und Zwetschgen haben in Deutschland im August und September Saison. Deshalb sieht man sie jetzt oft auf Märkten und in Bäckereien.
interestingFacts.en: Plums and damson plums are in season in Germany during August and September. This is why they are common now at markets and in bakeries.

topics.title: Die letzten warmen Tage nutzen
topics.englishTitle: Making the most of the last warm days
topics.englishContext: Early September can still bring warm, sunny days. Many people sit outside, go for a walk, visit a lake or take a small trip. They often want to enjoy the nice weather once more.

topics.title: Pläne fürs Wochenende
topics.englishContext: At the end of the week, many people talk about their weekend plans. Some meet friends, go for a walk or watch football. Others prefer to stay home and relax. Asking about the weekend is typical small talk at work.
